title: PETER
subtitle: the sound that made a grown man cry

lines.say: [groaning] UGH! ROOSTERS!
[knowingly] That sound once made a grown man cry.
[shocked] A ROOSTER?!
[storytelling] Peter was one of Jesus's closest friends. Loud, bold, always the first to speak.
cap: {g:Peter} was one of Jesus's closest friends.

lines.say: [confident] Lord, even if everyone else falls away, I never will. I'd die with you!
cap: “Lord, even if everyone else falls away,

lines.say: [gently] [sadly] Peter... before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.
[ominous] That same night, soldiers arrested Jesus. Peter followed at a distance, into the high priest's courtyard.
It was cold. So he stood by a charcoal fire, to keep warm.
cap: So he stood by a {o:charcoal fire},

lines.say: [suspicious] Wait... you were with him! You're one of his followers!
[nervous] Woman, I don't know him.
[accusing] You're one of them!
[defensive] I am NOT!
An hour later...
[certain] Your accent gives you away. You're from Galilee!
[shouting] [panicked] I DON'T KNOW THE MAN!
[softly] And right then... the rooster crowed.
[heartbroken] Jesus turned... and looked straight at Peter. And Peter went outside, and wept bitterly.
[quietly] [sad] ...No.
[softly] Three days later, Jesus rose from the dead. And later, at sunrise on the Sea of Galilee...
cap: Three days later, Jesus {g:rose from the dead}.

lines.say: Peter was out fishing. And someone on the shore was cooking breakfast. On a charcoal fire.
cap: And someone on the shore was cooking breakfast.

lines.say: [whispers] Another charcoal fire?
[warmly] Another charcoal fire.
[gently] Simon, son of John... do you love me?
[emotional] Yes, Lord. You know that I love you.
He asked him three times.
[crying] Lord, you know everything. You know that I love you.
[warmly] Then feed my sheep.
[tenderly] Three times he said no. Three times, Jesus let him say yes.
cap: Three times, Jesus let him say {g:yes}.

lines.say: [warmly] Your worst night isn't the end of your story. Jesus will meet you at the fire.
cap: Your worst night isn't the {o:end} of your story.
Jesus will meet you at the {g:fire}.

lines.say: [thoughtful] ...Okay. I'll be nicer to roost—
